ai_summary: AARNAV FASHIONS LIMITED reported a concerning H1 FY27, with revenue dropping approximately 7% year-over-year and profit before tax declining over 22%, signaling severe margin compression likely due to higher material costs relative to sales. This significant underperformance is the primary material impact and a red flag regarding operational efficiency or market demand. Separately, the Board approved an experienced new Additional Executive Director, Shri Lalchand Manfoolram Saharan.
